doc: Voice profiles for the openrouter engine of voice.mjs. A spec says WHICH KIND of voice it wants (voice.profile, e.g. documentary) and the tool resolves the name here, so changing a voice for a genre is one edit in this file, and a single spec can still pin a voice (voice.voice) or a style (voice.style). 'status' says how a choice was made: 'chosen by ear' = a human listened and picked it; 'proposal' = picked from the voice's published character (Google's descriptor in 'character'), NOT heard against the genre yet: audition before relying on it (node render/voice-audition.mjs). Voices of the Gemini models are multilingual: the same name speaks Russian and English.

characters._source: Google's Gemini TTS documentation (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation): the 30 prebuilt voices and their published character

default.status: fallback when a spec names no profile: the voice chosen for documentaries

documentary.status: chosen by ear (ru, Lyapunov script, 2026-10-01), against Charon, Orus and Sulafat
documentary.use: a story told calmly: a life, a history, a discovery

explainer.status: proposal (heard in the audition, no verdict); alternatives: Sadaltager (Knowledgeable), Rasalgethi (Informative)
explainer.use: how a thing works, a process, a number explained

assertive.status: proposal (heard in the audition, no verdict); alternative: Alnilam (Firm), Kore (Firm)
assertive.use: a statement, a verdict, a myth knocked down

warm.status: proposal (heard in the audition, no verdict); alternatives: Achird (Friendly), Vindemiatrix (Gentle)

energetic.status: proposal (never heard); alternatives: Fenrir (Excitable), Sadachbia (Lively), Laomedeia (Upbeat)
energetic.use: a countdown, a teaser, anything that must hurry
